Name: Daily Phone Quest
Author: ActionJackson22
Description:
[size=6]Introduction[/size]
[size=3]Villagers will call you with urgent requests that they need done today! They don't pay much but REALLY appreciate the effort! Greatly improves the usefulness of having a phone. This mod should be considered a BETA version, but early testing has yielded positive results.[/size]

[size=5]Premise[/size]
[size=3]This mod came about when during a recent play through, I kept missing villager birthdays. In my opinion, these missed days are extremely devastating for relationship goals. Normal quests and weekly gifting can only do so much, and require a lot of focus and attention that (at least in my experience) is better spent elsewhere. There had to be a middle ground where reasonable improvements can be made in a quicker time frame. Enter: Daily Phone Quests.
[/size]
[size=5]Description[/size]
[size=3]Every morning (8:30 am or earlier) your phone will ring with a random villager asking for an urgent item. You will be given the option to accept or reject the quest. This item is non-seasonal and can be pretty much anything you'd get from a normal quest. You only have that day to finish the quest, and it will reward you 500g and a FULL HEART of relationship standing with that person.
[/size]
[size=5]Receiving Phone calls[/size]
[size=3]Only people with 2+ hearts will call you. And your phone will not begin ringing with requests until you have at least 5 villagers at that level. You will not receive phone calls from your spouse, roommate, or ex spouse. For best results, consider putting a telephone anywhere you spend time in the early morning. It does not matter what phone you answer. The phone will ring for 30 minutes and hang up if no answer during that time.
[/size]
[size=5]Multiplayer[/size]
[size=3]I had some significant issues developing this for multiplayer, but I think I have it all fixed up. That being said, not everyone's phone call will come at the same time, and everyone will be presented their own random quest for the day.
[/size]
[size=5]Known issues[/size]
[size=3]Sometimes the phone call does not answer, well it rings, and you answer it, and nothing seems to happen. This has more to do with a limitation of how "answering" the phone works. After working with Pathoschild they assure me that in 1.6 this will be easier to handle, which should help with this problem.
[/size]
[size=5]Reporting issues[/size]
[size=3]Please put a thread on this site or feel free to message me on discord: ActionJackson#2104
[/size]
[size=5]Special Thanks[/size]
[size=3]Shout out to Pathoschild, frostyAtravita, Elizabeth, and a number of others from the Stardewvalley mod making channel on Discord.
[/size]
